centre.address: 441 4 Ave, Campbell River, BC V9W 3W7, Canada

about_blocks.text: Serves Aboriginal youth and adults who are dealing with addiction to alcohol or drugs. Counsellors employ various methods such as 12-step, sharing circles, rational emotive therapy, and brief therapy. Services include individual, family, and group counselling; brief intervention; and life skills training. Also provides counselling for those affected by another person’s substance misuse, self-help programs including addiction support groups and a men’s healing group. Does relapse prevention education. Has access to child care and transportation for clients.
